admission.justification: The seat identity is produced by the start answer and consumed by the dashboard chat route and its landing shape, so the promise only holds when those three agree.

applicability: The success answer of a registered Bootstrap role start, whether the host was already running or was prepared by this call.
conditions: The answer names the started seat's identity and the dashboard and chat addresses of that seat.
dashboardAddress is published only when the dashboard origin actually answers and the dashboard owner's action is not failed; otherwise the answer reports the owner/origin result.
chatAddress is honestly derived from the configured embed frame base URL, bridge-reported serverId and receipt agentId; this route is not an HTTP-probed chat-page witness.
A same-request retry reconciles to the same seat instead of starting a second one.
exclusions: A rendered-page witness of the dashboard.
Failure answers, which name their stage instead of a seat.

evidence: a2/native-review.md N3; final-a3/source-witnesses.md; mcp/tools/base.py and application/tool_response.py production completion path.

statement: The registered Bootstrap success response preserves its actual seat identity and usable dashboard/chat continuation.
